defects.detail: NOTE 2 cites 'Datasheet TJC-LLD-PF-GA-4501A'; KC-4501's datasheet is TJC-LLD-DS-KC-4501 (no PF series exists in the corpus).
PI 1201 (GA-1201A suction indicator) beside PT-4501; 'FROM STORAGE TANK 12-T-01' (Set 1's suction source) feeding the KO drum, where GA N1 reads 'From KO drum FA-4510'.

Title block REV. 02 / DATE. 02 and revision table rows '1 | 01 | 02', '2 | – | 02'; the KC-4501 GA drawing and plot plan are Rev 0 'ISSUED FOR CONSTRUCTION 05-06-2026' and the datasheet and C&E are REV 3.
TITLE cell reads 'KA-4501' where the equipment is KC-4501 (the second title cell reads 'P&ID: RECYCLE GAS COMPRESSOR (KC-4501) SYSTEM').

'PSLL-4501 Suction OPEN' puts Set 1's valve-position permissive text on the C&E T6 pressure trip (SEQ-4501 has no ZSO permissive); 'PSL-4504 Permissive 1' where C&E permissive 1 is PSLL-4504; XV-4501 on three valves; PSV-4502 drawn three times but absent from the datasheet and the C&E; VT-4501 (datasheet crosshead vibration monitor) drawn on the jacket cooling water line; a GEARBOX on a machine whose datasheet driver is a direct 4-pole motor.

C&E initiators T2 TSHH-4503, T3 PSHH-4502, T4 VSHH-4505 and T5 LSHH-4510 and effect EFF-4 'MAINTAIN SEAL GAS N2' are not drawn; the top-left TRIP box drives an actuator with no valve; line numbers '3"-HC-1002-CS021' and '4"-HC-602-CS021' echo Set 1's 4"-HC-1002-CS02-I; the large legend repeats rows (DCS/Local, P3/Interlock, FV, Line Spec/Line Specification/Line Specified, 'gate Type'); the notes end with the dangling line 'Materials of construction.'.

The sheet captions the recycle valving 'ANTI-SURGE RECYCLE CONTROL VALVING.' and TJC-LLD-IL-KC-4501 EFF-2 reads 'OPEN ANTI-SURGE RECYCLE FV-4502', but surge is a phenomenon of dynamic compressors and KC-4501 is typed reciprocating in three places: TJC-LLD-DS-KC-4501 'RECIPROCATING COMPRESSOR DATA SHEET', 'TYPE Reciprocating Compressor (2-stage)', 'COMPRESSOR TYPE RECIPROCATING, 2-STAGE, 2-THROW' and TJC-LLD-GA-KC-4501 'Type:ReciprocatingCompressor(2-stage)'. OPL-KC-4501-04 carries both readings itself: titled 'Anti-Surge / Recycle Operation' with step 5 'Investigate any repeated surge cycling with the vendor curve', while its purpose line uses the machine's own term, 'The recycle (spillback) valve protects the machine at low throughput'. Reported as a naming conflict, not resolved here (golden GS-102).
